name: firstmate
description: Claude Code mods for running firstmate.

plugins.name: wake-meter
plugins.description: Shows how much of the 5-hour and weekly allowance is left and what firstmate's notifications cost in its primary session, and nudges a restart when context grows.

plugins.name: crew-seatbelt
plugins.description: Refuses the shell actions that have cost firstmate workers their work or moved the captain's screen; active only in worker sessions.

plugins.name: guard-translator
plugins.description: Explains a firstmate guard refusal in plain words and offers the fixed command.

plugins.name: disk-sentinel
plugins.description: Quiet free-space sentinel that surfaces in the status line only near or below its threshold, plus a /targets listing of build-cache dirs and whether a live task still owns them.

plugins.name: fleet-deck
plugins.description: The captain's deck for firstmate's primary session: a band with calls, workers, PRs, monitoring and disk, a Calls pane that records answers, and a Fleet pane with a peek key.

plugins.name: nm-monitor
plugins.description: An on-demand pane, opened with /nm, showing every no-mistakes run in the fleet: step and time on it, findings, decisions waiting, and PR links. Read-only.
